panels.description: Number of distinct repositories that had at least one successful production deploy reported on a cicd scope whose project does not map that repository, in the selected time range. Anything above 0 usually means a deployment source is still reporting under a project that no longer maps the repo; fix the source's project mapping and the count drops to 0 on the next collection. Repos are matched on normalized URLs (case, trailing slash and '.git' ignored).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM LOWER(t.repo_url))))) AS repos_affected
FROM (
  SELECT dc.repo_url
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.table = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.row_id = dc.cicd_scope_id
  WHERE dc.environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND dc.result = 'SUCCESS'
    AND $__timeFilter(dc.finished_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping rm
      JOIN repos r ON r.id = rm.row_id
      WHERE rm.table = 'repos' AND rm.project_name = pm.project_name
        AND TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM LOWER(dc.repo_url)))) = TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM LOWER(r.url))))
    )
) t

panels.title: Repos affected (range)

panels.description: Deployments reported on a cicd scope whose project does not currently map the deployment's repo. Usually a deployment source still reporting under a project that no longer maps the repo; the deployment and the PRs it first shipped are credited to that project. Fix the source's project mapping; rows disappear once no such deploy falls in the time range. The repo_projects column lists the projects that currently map the repo; an empty value means the repo is mapped to no project or its URL does not resolve to a repo. Repos are matched on normalized URLs (case, trailing slash and '.git' ignored).

defaults.noValue: No production deploy on a non-owning webhook in this range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT dc.finished_date AS "time", pm.project_name AS deployment_project, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT rm.project_name ORDER BY rm.project_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM project_mapping rm JOIN repos r ON r.id = rm.row_id WHERE rm.table = 'repos' AND TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM LOWER(r.url)))) = TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM LOWER(dc.repo_url))))) AS repo_projects, dc.repo_url, dc.cicd_scope_id, dc.commit_sha
FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.table = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.row_id = dc.cicd_scope_id
WHERE dc.environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND dc.result = 'SUCCESS'
  AND $__timeFilter(dc.finished_date)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping rm
    JOIN repos r ON r.id = rm.row_id
    WHERE rm.table = 'repos' AND rm.project_name = pm.project_name
      AND TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM LOWER(dc.repo_url)))) = TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM LOWER(r.url))))
  )
ORDER BY dc.finished_date DESC

panels.title: Production deploys on a webhook whose project does not map the repo

panels.description: Deployed PRs divided by distinct production deployments, per week, across all projects. Values above 2 (red band) mean batches of PRs are being attached to single deploys: typically the first deployment of a repo on a scope back-linking its whole history, or a repo that releases rarely. Check project_pr_metrics for the deployment_commit_id with the most PRs in that week.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(ppm.pr_deployed_date, '7d') AS "time",
       COUNT(*) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ppm.deployment_commit_id), 0) AS prs_per_deploy
FROM project_pr_metrics ppm
WHERE ppm.pr_deployed_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ppm.pr_deployed_date)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: PRs per production deploy, weekly

panels.description: Successful production deployments in the range that were reported on a cicd scope whose project does not map the deployment's repo.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS affected_deployments
FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.table = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.row_id = dc.cicd_scope_id
WHERE dc.environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND dc.result = 'SUCCESS'
  AND $__timeFilter(dc.finished_date)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping rm
    JOIN repos r ON r.id = rm.row_id
    WHERE rm.table = 'repos' AND rm.project_name = pm.project_name
      AND TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM LOWER(dc.repo_url)))) = TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM LOWER(r.url))))
  )

panels.title: Affected deployments (range)

panels.description: One row per repo whose deployments were reported on a cicd scope of a project that does not map it. deployment_projects/deployment_scopes: where the deployments were reported; repo_projects: who maps the repo today (empty = nobody, or the URL does not resolve to a repo).

defaults.noValue: No production deploy on a non-owning webhook in this range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.repo_url_norm AS repo_url, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.project_name ORDER BY t.project_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS deployment_projects, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.cicd_scope_id ORDER BY t.cicd_scope_id SEPARATOR ', ') AS deployment_scopes, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT rm.project_name ORDER BY rm.project_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM project_mapping rm JOIN repos r ON r.id = rm.row_id WHERE rm.table = 'repos' AND TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM LOWER(r.url)))) = t.repo_url_norm) AS repo_projects, COUNT(*) AS deployments, MIN(t.finished_date) AS first_deployment, MAX(t.finished_date) AS last_deployment
FROM (
  SELECT dc.finished_date, TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM LOWER(dc.repo_url)))) AS repo_url_norm, pm.project_name, dc.cicd_scope_id
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.table = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.row_id = dc.cicd_scope_id
  WHERE dc.environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND dc.result = 'SUCCESS'
    AND $__timeFilter(dc.finished_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping rm
      JOIN repos r ON r.id = rm.row_id
      WHERE rm.table = 'repos' AND rm.project_name = pm.project_name
        AND TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM LOWER(dc.repo_url)))) = TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM LOWER(r.url))))
    )
) t
GROUP BY t.repo_url_norm
ORDER BY deployments DESC
